messages:
Maria: Heads-up — planning a config rollout for per-tenant batching tonight 22:00 PST (quiet window). Need: who flips, who runs smoke, rollback owner.
Aj: I can do the flip if someone owns rollback/metrics watching. I'll be online 21:45–23:30 PST.
Sam: I’ll run the smoke checklist immediately after flip. Will validate:
- 10 sample tenants for latency regression
- 1k token p50/p95 on gen routes
- embedding correctness quick sample
I'll post results in thread.
Leo: I'll watch APM & traces. Alert me if p95 > 750ms or error-rate +0.5%.
Maria: Flip command (dry-run tested):
```
./configctl set feature.per_tenant_batching=true --env=prod --dry-run=false --reason="rolling batch rollout 22:00"
```
Rollback (fast):
```
./configctl set feature.per_tenant_batching=false --env=prod --reason="rollback"
```
Also enable safe-defaults:
```
./configctl set feature.per_tenant_batching.safe_default=true
```
Maria: Ops playbook: if smoke fails, Aj triggers rollback, Sam posts smoke log + quick link to failed traces, Leo un-tags the rollout and escalates to eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved for 2026-04-01 22:00 PST — reminder in 1h and 15m.
Aj: Ack. I'll flip at :00, run quick sanity curl against /health and /v1/generate, then hand back to Sam for deeper checks.
Sam: Plan for smoke run:
1) Run `curl -sS https://prod.example/health` (expect 200)
2) Run `python smoke/check_gen.py --tenants 10 --tokens 500` and paste output
3) Run embedding sample (3 vectors)
If anything >2x baseline or errors, I'll call rollback.
Leo: Sharing dashboard link: https://grafana.company/r/redwood/perf?panelId=42 — will annotate timeframe.
Maria: Great — I'll push a preflight note to #general 30m before and schedule a quick rollback drill afterwards. Thanks all :rocket:
